programme.title: Deewane Huye Paagal
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder committed by a gangster, a young girl named Tanya flees to Dubai. Her friend Karan, who loves her, goes after her only to realise that she is pursued by a few more suitors, including the gangster himself.

programme.title: Dhol
programme.desc: Four young loafers wish to simplify their life by wooing a loaded heiress. Unfortunately, there's only one rich girl in the neighbourhood. The boys scamper to woo her first, not knowing that their efforts would lead them right into a murder mystery.

programme.title: Johnny Gaddaar
programme.desc: A gang member betrays his partners for money, setting off a dangerous chain of events.

programme.title: EMI
programme.desc: A film that tells the story of a group of people who fall prey to credit card debt and are struggling to repay their loans. They come together to form a support group and devise a plan to fight against the corrupt practices of the credit card companies. The movie highlights the consequences of reckless spending and the importance of financial literacy in an engaging and thought-provoking plot.

programme.title: Zila Ghaziabad
programme.desc: A gang war erupts between corrupt chairman Brahampal and gangster Fauji. Betrayal and shifting loyalties escalate the conflict, plunging the village into chaos and violence as personal vendettas drive the characters towards an uncertain future.
